comparison.objective: Pull out a spring-return tape and make one accurate mark at 300 mm.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually hold a sprung slider while positioning and dabbing a pen.
comparison.success_condition: Make one measured mark within 4 mm of 300 mm with the tape extended past it, then lift the pen and hold the state for one second.
comparison.reason: Although both tasks stabilize a narrow tool bimanually, this tests measurement and marking against spring return, not impact fracture and fragment containment.
